description: This PHP class 'Language' manages language data for the OpenCart admin interface. It provides methods to generate and clear language JSON files for different languages configured in the system.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language files within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates language JSON files for all configured languages, creating necessary directories and saving data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing language JSON files for all configured languages.
